Wind Turbine Operations Report

This report analyses 6,544 hours of operational wind turbine data. The system produced a mean Active Power (kW) of 1,307.7 across all operational periods. Overall Efficiency against the reference averaged 88.4%. Peak mean output occurred in March 2018, suggesting the strongest resource period in this window. The measured power curve follows the IEC 61400-12-1 binned methodology: operational readings are grouped into 0.5 m/s wind-speed bins, and the bin means form the measured curve. 18564 anomalous readings were flagged during this period and are detailed in the Anomaly Report.
